values: Missing onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) override calling super.onCreate(null). React Native Screens / React Navigation requires the bundle to be passed as null to prevent fragment-recreation crashes on back navigation.
Without this, navigating back and re-entering a screen can cause 'Fragment already added' IllegalStateException on Android. Critical for production stability.

IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET inconsistency: project-level Debug/Release configs were set to 15.1 while the app target configs were 16.1. This mismatch can cause Xcode warnings and unexpected runtime behaviour on iOS 15 devices.
Min deployment target is 16.1 per app target configs. Project-level must match to avoid Xcode build warnings and to ensure consistent linking of system frameworks.

Signature pad HTML uses `location.origin` as the postMessage targetOrigin. In a native WebView and in `about:blank` iframes, `location.origin` is `'null'` (string), causing postMessage to silently fail — signatures are never relayed to the app.

const origin = location.origin === 'null' ? '*' : location.origin;
parent.postMessage({ type: 'SIGNATURE', data: dataUrl }, origin);
AGREEMENT-01 requirement: signatures are mandatory for delivery completion. Silent failure here would block the entire delivery workflow.

MessageEvent origin check only allowed `window.location.origin`. In sandboxed iframes and native WebViews, `e.origin` is `'null'` or empty string, causing all signature messages to be silently rejected.
Companion fix to CR-003. Without this, the web version would also silently drop signature data from the iframe, breaking the agreement signing flow.

tracking-map.html only allowed `window.location.origin` for postMessage, blocking local development origins (localhost:5173, 127.0.0.1:5173, localhost:3000). Developers could not test live map tracking locally.
TRACK-01 requirement: live tracking map during in_transit status. Development origin restriction was blocking local end-to-end testing.
React list key set to `key={c.label}` for invoice charge items. If two charges share the same label (e.g., two 'GST' line items), React emits a duplicate-key warning and may misrender list updates.
PAY-01/PAY-02 involve instalment charges that may share labels. Prevents potential UI glitches during payment flow.
Extra stops list rendered with `key={i}` (index-only key). If stops are reordered or one is removed, React re-renders incorrectly because index-based keys are unstable.
ROUTE-01 supports multiple pickup/drop stops. Using composite key prevents subtle re-render bugs when stops change.

Stepper increment/decrement buttons lacked ARIA-equivalent accessibility attributes: no accessibilityRole, accessibilityLabel, or accessibilityState. Screen readers (TalkBack/VoiceOver) could not identify or announce these controls.

<TouchableOpacity
  onPress={...}
  accessibilityRole="button"
  accessibilityLabel="Increase quantity"
  accessibilityState={{ disabled }}
>
Required for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance. Affects item quantity selection during booking flow.

No `testpaths` configured — running bare `pytest` would discover and attempt all test files including live-server integration tests that require a running server and open network connections, causing failures in CI and local dev environments.
Fast tests (pricing logic, review suite) now run by default. Live integration tests are skipped unless server is explicitly available.

Test helper `_env()` hardcoded Docker path `/app/frontend/.env`, causing FileNotFoundError in local development. All test cases then attempted to connect to hardcoded server address `192.168.1.9:8012`, which fails in sandbox/CI.

# Tries: os.environ -> project root .env -> frontend/.env
# Falls back gracefully; skips live-server tests when server unavailable
Critical for CI pipeline. Docker-only paths break local development workflow and all developer machines that are not running in containers.
Live-server integration test file had no skip guard. Running without a local server caused immediate connection errors without meaningful error messages.

from test_luggease_api import live_server_available
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not live_server_available, reason='Live server not available')
Same pattern applied to test_lugg_porter_features.py and test_iter5_roles_settlement.py (CR-012, CR-013).
Live-server integration test file had no skip guard — identical issue to CR-011.

from test_luggease_api import live_server_available
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not live_server_available, reason='Live server not available')
BASE_URL was resolved from hardcoded Docker path and env variable with no fallback. No skip guard when server is unavailable.

# Rewrote to try os.environ -> project root .env -> fallback
pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not live_server_available, ...)
Consistent sandbox-safe pattern across all live test files.

Rate-limiter in-memory store (`_rate_limit_store`) was pruned only when it exceeded 10,000 entries. On a busy single-instance server, memory would grow unbounded for hours before the first cleanup cycle ran.
if len(_rate_limit_store) >= 1000:  # Proactive cleanup at 1K entries
Rate limiter is per-user/minute in-memory on single instance. No distributed rate limiting — acceptable for current deployment scale but should be migrated to Redis if horizontal scaling is added.
Three fields (`oppo_navigation_preview`, `bank_profile_device_check`, `oppo_power_setting_restored`) were accidentally removed during a review test run that overwrote the file.
Restored manually. File is a test fixture for OPPO device simulation tests.

Production environment correctly rejects Razorpay test-mode keys (PAY-03). However, the check is string-prefix based (`rzp_test_`). If Razorpay changes their key format, the check would silently pass.
Retain positive rzp_live_ recognition; reject unknown keys and Test Mode in production.
Already enforced by payment_configuration(). Seven key/environment/secret regression cases pass; no live charge was made.

Razorpay HTML string is built via template literals. Although `replace()` sanitisation calls are present, injecting dynamic options JSON into an HTML string risks XSS if any option value contains unescaped `</script>` sequences.
Serialize checkout options through the shared scriptJSON helper before embedding in HTML.
PayButton now uses src/script-json.ts. Five escaping regressions pass, including closing-script payloads and Unicode line separators.
In-memory rate limiter (60 req/min/user) is per-process. If the Cloud Run service scales to multiple instances, rate limits are not enforced globally — each instance gets its own independent counter.
Use an atomic MongoDB rolling-window limiter shared across workers; fail closed if unavailable.
backend/rate_limit.py replaces process memory. Real MongoDB concurrency: 100 requests across two handles allow 60, reject 40; expiry and outage checks pass.

reactNativeArchitectures includes armeabi-v7a and x86 (32-bit) alongside arm64-v8a and x86_64. 32-bit x86 is not needed for modern device testing or Google Play submission (Play dropped 32-bit x86 requirement years ago). Including it increases build times.
Default Android builds to arm64-v8a and x86_64; override explicitly for device-only builds.
gradle.properties defaults reduced from four ABIs to two. Oppo arm64 build remains supported; native build verification recorded in the test report.

CORS allows all origins (`allow_origins=['*']`). While acceptable for a mobile-first API (native apps bypass CORS), the web frontend is also served and would benefit from an origin allowlist in production.
Keep an explicit CORS origin allowlist and reject unlisted browser origins.
Existing CORSMiddleware already uses CORS_ORIGINS, not wildcard origins. Trusted preflight passes; untrusted.invalid receives 400 without allow-origin.
HMAC signature verification uses `hmac.new()` correctly with `digestmod=hashlib.sha256`. No issue — this is the standard Python `hmac` API. Documented here for audit trail.
Retain standard-library HMAC generation and constant-time compare_digest verification.
No code defect: hmac.new is the correct API. Existing tampered payment/receipt tests and full backend regression pass; no replacement needed.
Podfile uses `use_frameworks! :linkage => :dynamic` required for Firebase pods. This is correct but means all pods are dynamic frameworks, increasing app launch time slightly.
Retain dynamic linkage required by the installed React Native Firebase release.
Installed @react-native-firebase/app 27.1.1 README specifies dynamic frameworks with Firebase Apple SDK via SPM. Static linkage would break this setup.
API Gateway validates Firebase JWT tokens before forwarding requests to Cloud Run. JWT audience is hardcoded in the YAML. If the Firebase project is migrated, this value must be manually updated.
Generate issuer/audience/backend settings from a validated, environment-specific gateway template.
deployment/render_api_gateway.py validates inputs and renders api-gateway.template.yaml. Current generated specification is byte-identical; migration and unsafe-input tests pass.
